tools.name: place_cube
tools.title: Place Cube
tools.description: Places one or more cubes at the given positions. Texture is optional. Parenting: set a per-element `parent` (group/bone) inside each `elements[]` entry to parent cubes to different bones in a single call, or use the top-level `group` as a shared default. Parented cubes keep their authored world position and rotate correctly around the parent bone's origin (no coordinate rebasing needed).

parent.description: Per-element destination group/bone for THIS cube: a group UUID or name, or "root" for the top level. Overrides `place_cube`'s top-level `group` for this element, so a single call can parent different cubes to different bones (e.g. a humanoid body where each box belongs to a different limb). An unknown name falls back to the top-level `group` (or root). The cube keeps its authored world from/to and rotates correctly around the parent bone's origin.
parent.markdownDescription: Per-element destination group/bone for THIS cube: a group UUID or name, or "root" for the top level. Overrides `place_cube`'s top-level `group` for this element, so a single call can parent different cubes to different bones (e.g. a humanoid body where each box belongs to a different limb). An unknown name falls back to the top-level `group` (or root). The cube keeps its authored world from/to and rotates correctly around the parent bone's origin.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply to the cube.
texture.markdownDescription: Texture ID or name to apply to the cube.

group.description: TOP-LEVEL batch default: a single destination group/bone applied to all cubes that do NOT carry their own `parent`. Accepts a group UUID or name, or "root" for the top level. For a parented hierarchy in one call, set `parent` per element in `elements[]` (it overrides this); this top-level value then acts as the fallback for elements without a `parent`. An unknown name falls back to root (no error).
group.markdownDescription: TOP-LEVEL batch default: a single destination group/bone applied to all cubes that do NOT carry their own `parent`. tools.name: find_elements_by_criteria
tools.title: Find Elements by Criteria
tools.description: Searches the current project for elements matching the given criteria. Supports name matching (regex, substring, prefix, suffix), type filtering, scoping to a parent group, cube size ranges, selection scope, center-in-region (region_min/max), cube-box intersection (bbox_overlaps), per-face enabled, and texture (texture_name/texture_uuid). All supplied filters are AND-combined. Returns element metadata, never modifies state.

name_pattern.description: Regex pattern to match element names (e.g., '^arm_.*'). Case-sensitive.
name_pattern.markdownDescription: Regex pattern to match element names (e.g., '^arm_.*'). Case-sensitive.

name_contains.description: Substring to match in element names. Case-insensitive.
name_contains.markdownDescription: Substring to match in element names. Case-insensitive.

type.description: Restrict to a single element type.
type.markdownDescription: Restrict to a single element type.

parent_group.description: UUID or name of a parent group. Only descendants of this group are returned.
parent_group.markdownDescription: UUID or name of a parent group. Only descendants of this group are returned.

min_size.description: Minimum [x,y,z] size for cubes. Cubes smaller on any axis are excluded.
min_size.markdownDescription: Minimum [x,y,z] size for cubes. Cubes smaller on any axis are excluded.

max_size.description: Maximum [x,y,z] size for cubes. Cubes larger on any axis are excluded.
max_size.markdownDescription: Maximum [x,y,z] size for cubes. Cubes larger on any axis are excluded.

region_min.description: Region filter lower bound [x,y,z]. Keeps only elements whose position is >= this on every axis — cube center for cubes, origin for meshes. Groups are excluded when a region filter is set. Use with `region_max` to query a zone (e.g. a receiver bounding box).
region_min.markdownDescription: Region filter lower bound [x,y,z]. Keeps only elements whose position is >= this on every axis — cube center for cubes, origin for meshes. Groups are excluded when a region filter is set. Use with `region_max` to query a zone (e.g. a receiver bounding box).

region_max.description: Region filter upper bound [x,y,z]. Keeps only elements whose position is <= this on every axis (cube center / mesh origin).
region_max.markdownDescription: Region filter upper bound [x,y,z]. Keeps only elements whose position is <= this on every axis (cube center / mesh origin).

face_enabled.description: Keep only cubes whose given face (north/south/east/west/up/down) is enabled. Non-cube elements are excluded when set.
face_enabled.markdownDescription: Keep only cubes whose given face (north/south/east/west/up/down) is enabled. Non-cube elements are excluded when set.

name_prefix.description: Keep only elements whose name starts with this string. Case-sensitive.
name_prefix.markdownDescription: Keep only elements whose name starts with this string. Case-sensitive.

name_suffix.description: Keep only elements whose name ends with this string. Case-sensitive.
name_suffix.markdownDescription: Keep only elements whose name ends with this string. Case-sensitive.

texture_name.description: Keep only cubes/meshes with at least one face using the texture of this name. Case-insensitive. Non-textured elements are excluded when set.
texture_name.markdownDescription: Keep only cubes/meshes with at least one face using the texture of this name. Case-insensitive. Non-textured elements are excluded when set.

texture_uuid.description: Keep only cubes/meshes with at least one face using the texture with this UUID (or short numeric id). More precise than `texture_name`.
texture_uuid.markdownDescription: Keep only cubes/meshes with at least one face using the texture with this UUID (or short numeric id). More precise than `texture_name`.

min.description: Lower corner [x,y,z] of the query box.
min.markdownDescription: Lower corner [x,y,z] of the query box.

max.description: Upper corner [x,y,z] of the query box.
max.markdownDescription: Upper corner [x,y,z] of the query box.

bbox_overlaps.description: Keep only cubes whose axis-aligned from/to box INTERSECTS this region (unlike `region_min`/`region_max`, which test only the center point). Meshes and groups are excluded when set.
bbox_overlaps.markdownDescription: Keep only cubes whose axis-aligned from/to box INTERSECTS this region (unlike `region_min`/`region_max`, which test only the center point). Meshes and groups are excluded when set.

limit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of results to return.

add_to_selection.description: If true, add to current selection. If false, replace selection.
add_to_selection.markdownDescription: If true, add to current selection. If false, replace selection.

parent_group.description: UUID or name of a parent group. If provided, only descendants of this group are selected.
parent_group.markdownDescription: UUID or name of a parent group. If provided, only descendants of this group are selected.

tools.name: filter_by_material
tools.title: Filter Elements by Material
tools.description: Returns all elements that reference the given texture. For cubes, includes the list of face keys (e.g., 'north', 'up') that use the texture. For meshes, returns the mesh if any face uses the texture.

texture.description: Texture ID, UUID or name to search for.
texture.markdownDescription: Texture ID, UUID or name to search for.

include_face_keys.description: Include the list of cube face keys (e.g., 'north') that reference the texture.
include_face_keys.markdownDescription: Include the list of cube face keys (e.g., 'north') that reference the texture.

tools.name: get_element_info
tools.title: Get Element Info
tools.description: Returns full structured data for elements as JSON. Cubes: from/to, computed size, origin, rotation, inflate, box-UV settings, visibility/shade, and (by default) per-face uv/texture/rotation/tint/enabled. Meshes: origin/rotation, vertex & face counts, local bounding box, and optionally full vertices/faces. Groups: transform + child count. Scope via `ids` (specific elements), `group` (its descendants), `selected_only`, or omit all for the whole project. Read-only. Pair with `list_outline` for the hierarchy, or `find_elements_by_criteria` to get IDs first. This is the structured-dump primitive for offline analysis — use instead of `risky_eval`.

ids.description: Specific element IDs or names (cubes, meshes, or groups). Takes precedence over `group` and `selected_only`.
ids.markdownDescription: Specific element IDs or names (cubes, meshes, or groups). Takes precedence over `group` and `selected_only`.

group.description: UUID or name of a group — returns all of its descendant elements. Used when `ids` is omitted.
group.markdownDescription: UUID or name of a group — returns all of its descendant elements. Used when `ids` is omitted.

selected_only.description: Return only the currently selected elements. Used when both `ids` and `group` are omitted. If everything is omitted, the whole project is returned.
selected_only.markdownDescription: Return only the currently selected elements. Used when both `ids` and `group` are omitted. If everything is omitted, the whole project is returned.

include_groups.description: Include group nodes (transform + child count) in broad scopes (group/selection/all). Groups named explicitly via `ids` are always included.
include_groups.markdownDescription: Include group nodes (transform + child count) in broad scopes (group/selection/all). Groups named explicitly via `ids` are always included.

include_faces.description: For cubes, include per-face data (uv, texture, rotation, tint, enabled). Set false for a lighter geometry-only dump.
include_faces.markdownDescription: For cubes, include per-face data (uv, texture, rotation, tint, enabled). Set false for a lighter geometry-only dump.

include_mesh_geometry.description: For meshes, include full vertices and faces. Off by default — meshes otherwise return counts + local bounding box only, since full vertex dumps can be large.
include_mesh_geometry.markdownDescription: For meshes, include full vertices and faces. Off by default — meshes otherwise return counts + local bounding box only, since full vertex dumps can be large.

limit.description: Maximum number of elements to return.
limit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of elements to return.

tools.name: move_to_group
tools.title: Move Elements to Group
tools.description: Reparents existing elements (cubes, meshes, or groups) into a target group, or to the top level with `target_group: "root"`. The complement to `add_group` (which only creates empty groups) — this is how you organize a flat import (e.g. a Java model from `from_java_model`) into logical groups. Semantic grouping logic stays in the caller: compute which elements go where from a `get_element_info` dump, then issue the moves. Refuses to move a group into itself or its own descendant. Returns a JSON summary.

ids.description: Element IDs or names to move (cubes, meshes, or groups). Reparents existing elements — does not duplicate.
ids.markdownDescription: Element IDs or names to move (cubes, meshes, or groups). Reparents existing elements — does not duplicate.

target_group.description: Destination group UUID or name, or the literal "root" to move to the top level. The AI computes which elements belong where (e.g. from a `get_element_info` dump); this tool just performs the move.
target_group.markdownDescription: Destination group UUID or name, or the literal "root" to move to the top level. The AI computes which elements belong where (e.g. from a `get_element_info` dump); this tool just performs the move.

tools.name: export_model_structure
tools.title: Export Model Structure
tools.description: Bulk one-shot JSON dump of the model: project metadata, the full group hierarchy, every element (cube/mesh) with geometry (and per-face data by default), textures, and optionally an animation summary. Scope to the whole project, the current selection, or a group's subtree. Use this for offline analysis, archetype extraction, or as the `before`/`after` input to `compare_models` — it replaces dozens of `get_element_info` roundtrips with a single call. Respects `max_elements` and flags `truncated` when capped.

scope.description: What to export: whole project, current selection, or a named group's subtree.
scope.markdownDescription: What to export: whole project, current selection, or a named group's subtree.

group.description: Group UUID or name — required when scope=group.
group.markdownDescription: Group UUID or name — required when scope=group.

include_animations.description: Include an animation summary (name, length, loop, animated bone count).
include_animations.markdownDescription: Include an animation summary (name, length, loop, animated bone count).

max_elements.description: Cap on exported elements. When exceeded, `truncated` is set true.
max_elements.markdownDescription: Cap on exported elements. When exceeded, `truncated` is set true.

tools.name: get_bounding_box
tools.title: Get Bounding Box
tools.description: Returns the aggregated axis-aligned bounding box ({min,max,center,extents}) of the selection, a named group, the whole project, or only visible elements. `world` space accounts for rotations and parent transforms (use for auto-framing screenshots); `local` space is the raw from/to + vertex extent ignoring rotation. Replaces ad-hoc `risky_eval` bbox queries.

target.description: What to measure: current selection, a named group's subtree, the whole project, or only currently-visible elements.
target.markdownDescription: What to measure: current selection, a named group's subtree, the whole project, or only currently-visible elements.

group_id.description: Group UUID or name — required when target=group.
group_id.markdownDescription: Group UUID or name — required when target=group.

coordinate_space.description: `world` = transformed scene-space AABB (accounts for rotation/parent transforms; best for camera framing). `local` = axis-aligned over raw cube from/to and mesh vertices, ignoring element rotation.
coordinate_space.markdownDescription: `world` = transformed scene-space AABB (accounts for rotation/parent transforms; best for camera framing). `local` = axis-aligned over raw cube from/to and mesh vertices, ignoring element rotation.

tools.name: highlight_elements
tools.title: Highlight Elements
tools.description: Temporarily highlights elements in the viewport — non-destructive (geometry and materials are never modified). Without `color`, highlights via selection. With `color` (hex), also draws a colored box overlay (THREE.Box3Helper) around each element. With `duration_ms > 0` the highlight is removed and the prior selection restored afterward (a flash); a colored overlay without a duration defaults to a 2000 ms flash so it self-cleans. Useful for visually confirming `find_elements_by_criteria` results.

ids.description: Element IDs or names to highlight in the viewport.
ids.markdownDescription: Element IDs or names to highlight in the viewport.

color.description: Optional hex color for a temporary colored box overlay drawn around each element (non-destructive — a THREE.Box3Helper, never touches geometry or materials). When set, a `duration_ms` of 0 is treated as a 2000 ms flash, because the overlay must be auto-removed (there is no later MCP handle to clear it). When omitted, elements are highlighted via selection instead.
color.markdownDescription: Optional hex color for a temporary colored box overlay drawn around each element (non-destructive — a THREE.Box3Helper, never touches geometry or materials). When set, a `duration_ms` of 0 is treated as a 2000 ms flash, because the overlay must be auto-removed (there is no later MCP handle to clear it). When omitted, elements are highlighted via selection instead.

duration_ms.description: If > 0, the highlight is removed and the previous selection restored after this many milliseconds (a temporary flash). 0 leaves the selection highlight in place (or, with `color`, defaults to a 2000 ms flash).
duration_ms.markdownDescription: If > 0, the highlight is removed and the previous selection restored after this many milliseconds (a temporary flash). 0 leaves the selection highlight in place (or, with `color`, defaults to a 2000 ms flash).

clear_previous.description: Replace the current selection (true) or add the highlighted elements to it (false).
clear_previous.markdownDescription: Replace the current selection (true) or add the highlighted elements to it (false).

tools.title: Group Elements by Criteria

Speeds up organizing flat imports into logical zones (e.g. receiver/barrel/stock). Creates the group under `parent_group` (default root). Groups themselves are never moved. Returns the new group's UUID and the moved element list.

group_name.markdownDescription: Name for the new group to create.

parent_group.description: Parent group UUID or name, or "root" for the top level (default).
parent_group.markdownDescription: Parent group UUID or name, or "root" for the top level (default).

type.description: Restrict to a single element type (groups are never moved).
type.markdownDescription: Restrict to a single element type (groups are never moved).

source_group.description: Only consider descendants of this group as candidates.
source_group.markdownDescription: Only consider descendants of this group as candidates.

region_min.markdownDescription: Region lower bound (cube center / mesh origin).

region_max.description: Region upper bound (cube center / mesh origin).
region_max.markdownDescription: Region upper bound (cube center / mesh origin).

texture_name.description: Only elements with a face using this texture name.
texture_name.markdownDescription: Only elements with a face using this texture name.

limit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of elements to move into the new group.

Read-only. Use when comparing reference models or budgeting poly counts.

scope.description: Aggregate over the whole project, current selection, or a named group's subtree.
scope.markdownDescription: Aggregate over the whole project, current selection, or a named group's subtree.

group.description: Group UUID or name — required when scope=group.
group.markdownDescription: Group UUID or name — required when scope=group.

only_current_format.description: If true, only return codecs compatible with the current project's format.
only_current_format.markdownDescription: If true, only return codecs compatible with the current project's format.

tools.name: export_model
tools.title: Export Model
tools.description: Compiles the current project through the named codec and returns the result as text (or base64 for binary codecs). Optionally writes the compiled content to a filesystem path (requires user permission in Blockbench v5.0+). Awaits async codecs (e.g. glTF/GLB in Blockbench 5.x). Use `list_export_formats` first to discover codec IDs. For glTF/GLB specifically, `export_gltf_silent` is a convenience wrapper with typed `embed_textures` / `animations` options.

codec_id.markdownDescription: Codec ID to use for export (e.g., 'obj', 'gltf', 'project', 'bedrock'). If omitted, uses the current project format's codec. Use `list_export_formats` to see available IDs.

options.markdownDescription: Codec-specific export options. Defaults to the codec's configured export options.

path.markdownDescription: Absolute filesystem path to write the compiled model to. Requires user permission (Blockbench v5.0+ prompts for 'fs' access). If omitted, content is returned in the response only.

max_content_length.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters to include in the returned `content` field. Use 0 to omit content entirely (useful when only writing to disk). Larger values risk exceeding MCP context limits.

tools.name: from_java_model
tools.title: Import Java Model
tools.description: Imports a raw Minecraft Java block/item model (.json with `elements`) programmatically — no file dialog. Accepts inline JSON, an http(s) URL, or a filesystem path. Returns a JSON summary (project name, format, element/cube counts). Set `ignore_textures: true` for geometry-only analysis. For OptiFine CIT / resource-pack models whose textures live under `assets/<ns>/textures/` (so Blockbench reports "File Not Found"), pass `assets_root` (or rely on auto-derivation from optifine/cit paths) to resolve textures correctly. Wraps the `java_block` codec; for Bedrock geometry use `from_geo_json` instead.

model.description: A Minecraft Java model as an inline JSON string, an http(s) URL, or an absolute filesystem path to a .json file (e.g. a mod's `models/item/*.json`). Raw element models — top-level `elements` with from/to/faces, like Hardt's Guns viewmodels — import directly. Models that only reference a `parent` import what they contain, but the parent's geometry is NOT resolved unless those assets are present.
model.markdownDescription: A Minecraft Java model as an inline JSON string, an http(s) URL, or an absolute filesystem path to a .json file (e.g. a mod's `models/item/*.json`). Raw element models — top-level `elements` with from/to/faces, like Hardt's Guns viewmodels — import directly. Models that only reference a `parent` import what they contain, but the parent's geometry is NOT resolved unless those assets are present.

import_to_current_project.description: false (default): open the model in a NEW Java Block/Item project tab, mirroring File > Import. true: add the model's elements into the currently open project as a new group (a project must already be open; the current project's name/export settings are left untouched).
import_to_current_project.markdownDescription: false (default): open the model in a NEW Java Block/Item project tab, mirroring File > Import. true: add the model's elements into the currently open project as a new group (a project must already be open; the current project's name/export settings are left untouched).

ignore_textures.description: false (default): import the model's `textures` block as usual. true: drop the `textures` block before import so the codec never tries to load texture files. Use this for geometry-only reference analysis, and to avoid Blockbench's blocking "Invalid Path" dialog when a model references texture paths with spaces/uppercase (illegal in Minecraft Java, common in mod source models). Geometry is unaffected.
ignore_textures.markdownDescription: false (default): import the model's `textures` block as usual. true: drop the `textures` block before import so the codec never tries to load texture files. Use this for geometry-only reference analysis, and to avoid Blockbench's blocking "Invalid Path" dialog when a model references texture paths with spaces/uppercase (illegal in Minecraft Java, common in mod source models). Geometry is unaffected.

assets_root.description: Absolute path to the resource pack's `assets/<namespace>` folder (e.g. `/path/pack/assets/minecraft`). Namespaced texture refs like `item/foo` then resolve to `<assets_root>/textures/item/foo.png`. Fixes OptiFine CIT (and other non-standard model locations) where Blockbench otherwise looks beside the model file and reports "File Not Found". If omitted and the model is loaded from a filesystem path containing `/optifine/` or `/cit/`, the assets root is auto-derived from the `/assets/<namespace>/` segment of that path. Ignored when `ignore_textures` is true.
assets_root.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the resource pack's `assets/<namespace>` folder (e.g. `/path/pack/assets/minecraft`). Namespaced texture refs like `item/foo` then resolve to `<assets_root>/textures/item/foo.png`. Fixes OptiFine CIT (and other non-standard model locations) where Blockbench otherwise looks beside the model file and reports "File Not Found". If omitted and the model is loaded from a filesystem path containing `/optifine/` or `/cit/`, the assets root is auto-derived from the `/assets/<namespace>/` segment of that path. Ignored when `ignore_textures` is true.

tools.name: reload_project

resources.name: nodes
resources.title: Blockbench Nodes
resources.description: Returns the current 3D nodes in the editor. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `nodes://head`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: textures
resources.title: Blockbench Textures
resources.description: Returns information about textures. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `textures://skin`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, slug, or short numeric texture id.

resources.name: reference_models
resources.title: Reference Models
resources.description: Returns reference models in the current project. Requires the Reference Models plugin. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `reference_models://turntable`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: validator-status
resources.title: Validator Status
resources.description: Returns the current validation status including error/warning counts and a summary of all problems.

resources.name: validator-checks
resources.title: Validator Checks
resources.description: Returns information about registered validator checks. Use without an ID to list all checks, or provide a check ID to get details about a specific check.

resources.name: validator-warnings
resources.title: Validator Warnings
resources.description: Returns all current validation warnings with element references where available.

resources.name: validator-errors
resources.title: Validator Errors
resources.description: Returns all current validation errors with element references where available.

resources.name: hytale-format
resources.title: Hytale Format Information
resources.description: Returns comprehensive information about the current Hytale format, including format type, block size, node limits, and feature support.

resources.name: hytale-attachments
resources.title: Hytale Attachments
resources.description: Returns information about attachment collections. List URIs use slugified collection names (e.g. `hytale://attachments/helmet`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: hytale-pieces
resources.title: Hytale Attachment Pieces
resources.description: Returns groups marked as attachment pieces — they connect to like-named bones in the main model. List URIs use slugified bone names (e.g. `hytale://pieces/hand-right`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision.

resources.name: hytale-cubes
resources.title: Hytale Cubes
resources.description: Returns cubes with Hytale-specific properties (shading_mode, double_sided, stretch). List URIs use slugified cube names (e.g. `hytale://cubes/torso`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision.
